boundaries: ECN-2 Status M material fit is distinct from APD/ADX output.
C-41/CN-16 camera negatives can use optical printing or experimental APD/ACES rendering; the motion-picture input transform has no stock-specific C-41 color validation.
E-6 Status A, K-14 Kodachrome, RA-4 reflection paper and movie print film must not share an unqualified material interpretation.
Only processed sensitivities from selected upstream profiles enter provisional negative materials; no processed/unmixed density_curves are treated as raw Status M.
No raw manufacturer PDF or profile table is bundled by this catalog.
